title: SEO Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on SEO Intern who wants to build a strong career in SEO and digital growth.

You will work across end\-to\-end SEO, including keyword research, content and blog writing, on\-page SEO, technical SEO, link building, local SEO and performance tracking.

This is a hands\-on role where you will work on live websites and real business outcomes, with the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as you grow.

Strong performers will have the opportunity to transition into a full\-time SEO role after the internship.

Key Responsibilities

\* Execute end\-to\-end SEO activities for our websites.

\* Conduct keyword research and identify new ranking opportunities.

\* Write and optimize SEO\-friendly blogs, landing pages, website content and FAQs.

\* Create content based on search intent and identify content gaps.

\* Perform on\-page SEO, including:

\* Title tags and meta descriptions

\* H1/H2/H3 optimization

\* Internal linking

\* Image optimization

\* URL structure

\* Content optimization

\* Assist with technical SEO, including identifying indexing, crawlability, broken links, redirects, sitemap and other website issues.

\* Work on off\-page SEO and link building, including competitor backlink analysis and outreach.

\* Work on local SEO, including Google Business Profile optimization.

\* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks and conversions.

\* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs/Semrush and Google Keyword Planner.

\* Analyze competitors and identify new SEO and content opportunities.

\* Regularly audit existing pages and improve their search performance.

\* Stay updated with \*\*Google algorithm changes and SEO best practices\*\*.

\* Prepare SEO reports and communicate progress, learnings and results.

What We’re Looking For

\* Strong interest in SEO and digital marketing.

\* Good written English and ability to write clear, engaging content.

\* Basic understanding of SEO, keywords, backlinks and search engines.

\* Analytical mindset and willingness to work with data.

\* Comfortable learning new SEO tools and website platforms.

\* Ability to independently research topics and execute tasks.

\* Proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership of work.

\* Someone who is looking to build a long\-term career in SEO, rather than simply complete an internship.

Good to Have

\* Previous SEO, content writing or digital marketing internship/project experience.

\* Knowledge of WordPress or other CMS platforms.

\* Familiarity with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and GA4\.

\* Basic understanding of HTML.

\* Experience writing or optimizing blogs for search engines.

\* Understanding of AI\-assisted content, GEO/AEO and emerging SEO practices.

What You’ll Get

\* Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end SEO.

\* Opportunity to work on live websites and real SEO growth projects.

\* Exposure to content strategy, technical SEO, local SEO and link building.

\* Direct learning and mentorship from the team.

\* Opportunity to take ownership of SEO projects as you gain experience.

\* Potential full\-time conversion based on performance during the internship.

\* Opportunity to grow into a larger SEO/growth role within the company.

Compensation \& Location

\*Stipend: ₹10,000/month

\*Location: Gurgaon

\*Work Mode: Hybrid

\*Experience: 0–1 year / Freshers welcome

Career Opportunity

We are looking at this internship as a potential long\-term hiring opportunity.

If you demonstrate strong execution, ownership and the ability to deliver results, you can be considered for a full\-time SEO position after the internship, with greater responsibility and career growth within the team.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Digital Marketing Executive to join Ambrosia Botanicals. This is a hands\-on, in\-office role for someone who enjoys the craft of brand building, is comfortable working across both digital and traditional marketing channels, and takes pride in getting every campaign right the first time. You will execute branding and communication strategies, create and manage content across platforms, plan and run paid campaigns, and help generate leads that fuel our growth. We are looking for someone eager to build a strong foundation in marketing within a fast\-growing, high\-energy wellness startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Execute branding and communication strategies across online and offline channels.

· Assist in designing and delivering campaigns for brand and product awareness and lead generation.

· Ideate and manage content for social media, email, and print materials.

· Plan and execute paid campaigns on platforms such as Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

· Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors for timely execution.

· Analyze campaign performance and prepare performance reports.

· Research market trends and competitor strategies to inform marketing decisions.

· Support the creation of pitch decks and marketing collateral for internal and external use.

· Ensure consistency in brand messaging and tone across all channels.

Pay: Up to ₹300,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Online Marketing Executive
description:
**Position: Brand Manager Online Marketing (Sexual Wellness Category Preferred)**

**Location:** Gurgaon

**Department:** Marketing

**Reporting To:** Marketing Executive

**About the Role**

We are seeking a dynamic and performance\-driven **Marketing Executive Online Marketing** to lead our digital brand strategy and drive growth across online platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in social media marketing, digital brand building, performance campaigns, and e\-commerce growth. Experience in the **sexual wellness / personal care / intimate care category** will be highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning

· Develop and execute comprehensive online brand strategies aligned with business goals.

· Strengthen brand positioning in the sexual wellness / personal care category.

· Ensure consistent brand communication across all digital touchpoints.

2\. Social Media Leadership

· Own and manage brand presence across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.

· Plan and execute engaging content calendars (reels, influencer collaborations, educational content, campaigns).

· Drive follower growth, engagement rate, and community building.

· Monitor trends and create viral, culturally relevant campaigns.

3\. Performance Marketing \& Digital Campaigns

· Plan and manage paid campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, etc.).

· Optimize CAC, ROAS, and conversion rates.

· Work closely with performance agencies and internal teams to scale revenue.

4\. E\-commerce \& Marketplace Growth

· Drive brand visibility and sales on Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, and D2C website.

· Optimize product listings, SEO keywords, creatives, and online merchandising.

· Plan promotional campaigns and marketplace ads.

5\. Influencer \& Affiliate Marketing

· Identify and onboard relevant influencers in lifestyle, health, and wellness space.

· Manage collaborations, content quality, and ROI tracking.

· Build affiliate partnerships and brand advocacy programs.

6\. Consumer Insights \& Analytics

· Track campaign performance using analytics tools.

· Derive insights from data to improve engagement and conversion.

· Monitor competitor activities and industry trends.

7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

· Coordinate with product, sales, creative, regulatory, and external agencies.

· Ensure compliance with advertising norms for sensitive categories like sexual wellness.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

· Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred).

· 1\-5 years of experience in digital/online brand management.

· Strong hands\-on experience in social media strategy and performance marketing.

· Experience in sexual wellness, intimate care, personal care, healthcare, or FMCG category preferred.

· Deep understanding of digital analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and marketplace dashboards.

· Excellent communication, creativity, and storytelling skills.

· Ability to handle sensitive category marketing with maturity and regulatory awareness.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹850,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How much experience do you have in Online Marketing ?
* Do You have experience in sexual wellness / personal care / intimate care category ?

Work Location: In person
